# matchedfilter tuning table
# cpu     AMD RYZEN AI MAX+ 395 w/ Radeon 8060S
# commit  bc0cd1e
# trials  20000 per cell (~11571 detections); rates below ~3e-04 are unresolved
#
# Measured by running the real filter against injections and counting the
# peaks the ungated filter reports that it does not. Regenerate with
#   python tools/hmf_tune.py  (see its docstring for what invalidates it)
# FDR rows are a property of the statistic; COST rows are a property of
# this machine and this build, and go stale independently.
#
# WARNING: the COST rows are not usable yet. They were timed on the FDR
# harness, which injects at the threshold so ~half of all pairs trigger
# whatever the band -- so every band reads 9-13 us/pair, where the real
# captures separate band 256 and 1024 by 23 ms/segment against 10. Cost is
# set by how often the gate opens on NOISE at the operating point and needs
# its own pure-noise run.
#
# SCOPE: n=4096 only, decision window = the full transform. A table for
# other transform lengths has to be generated separately.
#
# FDR  n band U K snr f beff dismissal
